content:
Evelyn: Heads-up 1AtlasPay POC starts Mon. Need hosted dev keys, a tiny Dedicated pool for perf (2 GPUs), and VPC peering to their staging. Requirements: BYOK (customer KMS), IP allowlist, audit logs to their S3, and quick security QA answers for their questionnaire. Also confirm POC credits vs invoice.

Priya: Quick q peak RPS and avg tokens per call? Which model & region?

Evelyn: Peak ~1k RPS short bursts, avg 4-6k tokens (summaries). Model: llm-2-xlarge, region us-west-2, 30-day eval.

Jordan: Short provisioning checklist:
- Create hosted API keys (name: atlaspay_poc_<env>_<date>) with IP allowlist.
- Open DP ticket (template below) for Dedicated pool.
- Start VPC peering request; need CIDR + AWS account id + route updates.
- BYOK: collect KMS ARN + cross-account grant.
- Audit: enable S3 delivery (SSE-KMS).

Sam: Security notes to add to Qs:
- BYOK supported (AWS KMS).
- All at-rest data encrypted; we recommend redaction of PII.
- Third-party pentest needs SOC signoff.

Marta: Pricing note: 2x A10G-equivalent ~ $3.5k/mo. For POCs we usually offer $10k credits + 1 complimentary Dedicated month. If they exceed credits, billing will notify them 3 days prior.

ops-bot: DP ticket created: DP-4642 (Dedicated pool request).

Priya: I'll own the runbook & send invite with checklist + Locust perf script for reproducibility.

Evelyn: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
